verdict.rationale: Orrick documents a dedicated Trademark, Copyright & Media practice whose team "manages thousands of trademarks for hundreds of clients," which supports trademark portfolio and registration work as its own team. The evidence does not describe clearance searching or brand enforcement, and the practice is combined with copyright and media rather than being trademark-only. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance and search services, brand enforcement and anti-counterfeiting or opposition work, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: the team manages thousands of trademarks for hundreds of clients ... from the smallest startups to the largest companies
